text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of summer camp.
It's a
period of intense training where
racers can
improve upon their practical
skills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Or... that's what it's supposed to be.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready, guinea pig? The number
of
experiments that can only be done
during the
summer rivals the number of
stars in space!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Don't give in to the heat. I'll need you to
be on
your best guinea pig behavior!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A full-fledged adult shouldn't concern
themselves
with such trifling matters.
Come, let's enjoy
summer!
choice_data_list_en: This is your 'summer training camp', you know?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Such was the calm before the inevitable
storm
that would ensue during summer
camp with Agnes
Tachyon!
